background_load: Keine parallelen Messungen, Agenten oder Builds; Videopipeline pausiert; Lastmittel vor Start 1.09 1.93 3.93

parameters.query_order: short word first, then long word

cases.verteilt: short list = long-list entries at (j+1)*df/10-1, j=0..9; last entry of long list included
cases.anfang: short list = first 10 entries of long list

parameters.schedule: shuffle all (algorithm,query) blocks per repetition; fixed seed
parameters.generator: fixed membership recipes; 100 tokens/doc; all query/filler tokens four ASCII characters; seeded filler and position shuffle; uppercase + punctuation; fixed-width file names
parameters.direct_search: search_direct_boolean only as correctness check before the first timer; not timed

timer: time.perf_counter_ns; integer elapsed_ns per complete block
cache: prepared corpus and prechecked index reused; no cold-cache measurement; load includes OS cache effects

timing_boundaries.load: complete public load_corpus on fixed disk files
timing_boundaries.preparation: complete public prepare_corpus on already loaded raw documents
timing_boundaries.build: complete public build_inverted_index on prepared documents
timing_boundaries.query: complete public search_index_boolean including query normalization, posting gathering, stable length sort, intersection and full fresh result list
timing_boundaries.block: five complete identical calls retained then checked; previous results deleted before next timer
timing_boundaries.excluded: generation, direct-search correctness check, diagnostics, disk output, summary and plotting; no memory instrumentation

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3, IQR; one block is one sample; quartiles are not confidence intervals
memory: not measured in series 03b; CSV index_bytes and peak_memory_bytes remain empty
